priority: P1 — make the Discord /dupla convidar seat order explicit and testable so host+partner are always the same team and the two opponents are the other team.

implementation.behavior: The command handler now delegates invite field normalization to buildTagInvite. The helper emits [host, opponent1, partner, opponent2], matching tagStore's alternating team assignment [0,1,0,1], preserves classic-loan/classic-owned/normal modes, defaults to classic-loan and rejects duplicate/blank IDs or unknown modes before creating a lobby.
implementation.integration: src/index.ts /dupla convidar now calls buildTagInvite and passes the validated seat order/rules to createTagLobby. A temporary SQLite integration test verifies the exact member/team order and confirms that creating a normal-mode lobby does not create player_cards, starter_grants or decks.

limitations: The slash command's pure seat-order builder and tagStore integration are tested offline; no live Discord interaction or deployment.
This is command routing and team-seat correctness, not a new card effect or certification.
